code='''def transform(grid):
    """Make a 2x2 block of the grid in its four quarter-turn orientations."""
    n = len(grid)
    if not n or any(len(row) != n for row in grid):
        raise ValueError("expected a non-empty square grid")
    top = [list(row) for row in grid]
    right = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]  # 90 degrees clockwise
    bottom_left = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]  # 90 degrees counterclockwise
    bottom_right = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])][::-1]  # 180 degrees
    return [top[r] + right[r] for r in range(n)] + [bottom_left[r] + bottom_right[r] for r in range(n)]
'''
